name: MMSIBench
intro: MMSI-Bench 是多图空间智能基准。六名 3D 视觉研究者从八个真实世界数据集、超过 12 万张候选图像中人工构建 1,000 道四选一问题，最终使用 1,990 张独立图像，并以详细推理、可信干扰项和三名独立审核者保证质量；论文评测 37 个 MLLM。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Zhejiang University, Tsinghua University, Shanghai Jiaotong University, University of Hong Kong, Beijing Normal University
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
eval_feature: 多图像空间推理, 推理标注, 错误分析
scale: 1,000个问题, 1,990张最终图像, 12万余候选图像
eval_feature_en: Multi-image spatial reasoning, reasoning annotations, error analysis
intro_en: MMSI-Bench evaluates multi-image spatial intelligence. Six 3D-vision researchers manually built 1,000 four-choice questions from more than 120,000 candidate images across eight real-world datasets, yielding 1,990 unique final images. Detailed reasoning, plausible distractors, and three independent reviewers support quality; the paper evaluates 37 MLLMs.

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit completed 2026-07-21 against the ICLR 2026 camera-ready arXiv:2505.23764v3, Sections 3-5 and Appendices E-F; v3 PDF SHA-256 b71c19f7cf7c89b84d99da13c41894c1c8ec93729ee921704f54c34fc6abf62a. The official repository is pinned at 13e58a2b8b30d880d7e8a1e4a6aa1c0feda94cac (2026-04-28); vlmeval/dataset/mmsi_bench.py SHA-256 is e551ea1d3ca87c72196dd837d5beec545398d06359bfc5d235558904cf95bec7. The public Hugging Face dataset is pinned at ec7c92bfaf7728fcca1d61e3e224e190af309436. Construction begins from more than 120,000 real-world candidate images and exactly 1,000 final questions sourced as Matterport3D 463, ScanNet 280, Ego4D 67, AgiBot-World 45, DTU 72, nuScenes 39, DAVIS 2017 29, and Waymo 5. Six 3D-vision researchers spend over 300 hours writing free-form English questions across six positional, two attribute, two motion, and one multi-step category. Every item must require cross-image integration and resist single-image or common-sense solution; non-multi-step items use exactly two images, while multi-step samples may use up to ten. Each item has four choices with one correct answer, plausible distractors, and detailed step-by-step reasoning; multi-step rationales contain 3-11 steps, mean 5.7. Three independent expert reviewers check every item for ambiguity, answer correctness, visual sufficiency, non-triviality, and rationale completeness; failed items are revised or replaced before final audit. The final set has 1,000 questions, 1,990 unique images, mean 2.55 images per question, and maximum ten. Camera-ready difficulty labels use two new human evaluators per item, normalized completion time, and direct Hard assignment after an incorrect human answer, yielding 605 Easy, 262 Medium, and 133 Hard. The pinned Parquet schema is id, images, question_type, question, answer, thought, mean_normed_duration_seconds, and difficulty. Data is declared CC BY 4.0, but the paper states this does not override the eight upstream datasets' licenses; the code repository has no top-level license, so openness is classified as partly public rather than treating download access as unrestricted reuse. Paper evaluation covers 37 MLLMs at temperature 0 and maximum 2,048 output tokens, plus equal-probability random guessing, blind GPT-4o, and the average of five independent human evaluators. Direct and Visual prompts request the option letter enclosed in backticks; Linguistic prompting prepends zero-shot chain-of-thought, and Visual prompting applies PATS marks. The paper reports exact match between extracted and gold letters and an LLM fallback after format failure. The pinned released evaluator first unwraps double or single backticks, then takes the first standalone A-D not followed by a word. Its default path returns None and zero on failure; a manually selected path used for Claude-3.7-Sonnet, Llama-3.2-11B-Vision, and Doubao thinking calls chatgpt-0125 up to three times and returns Z after exhaustion. Thus the release does not automatically send every format failure through the paper-described fallback. Every row present in the evaluation file increments total and extraction failures remain zero; a complete release evaluation therefore has denominator 1,000, but omitted rows are not inserted and an incomplete input file shrinks the denominator. Circular evaluation is a later repository feature and is not merged into the paper-v3 main result. Automated reasoning analysis supplies images, question, gold answer, and structured human reference reasoning, then classifies Grounding, Overlap-Matching/Scene-Reconstruction, Situation-Transformation, Spatial-Logic, or category 5 for fully correct reasoning; the paper reports 78% classifier accuracy with reference rationales versus 53% with the answer alone. The bilingual specs have identical 28-node, 33-edge topology, academic-paper/academic-color/orthogonal styling, default 11-point theme typography, and five decision nodes whose outgoing edges reach distinct real outcomes with bilingual labels. After a density-focused horizontal compaction that preserves 32-pixel terminal connector segments, temporary Desktop rendering was reviewed at 2,757 x 1,465 pixels and again at 90% (2,481 x 1,318) in both languages; no clipping, overlap, duplicate edge labels, or connector-node crossings were found. Formal publication evidence [site-a11o-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2757×1465 (English) and 2757×1465 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2755×1463 and 2755×1463. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
